content: Jesudi yoyout hekimalam kobut diniŋ hinamuni foloŋ kamekaaŋ yoguk
Jesu adi tomboyoula yoyout mede niŋ indiŋ yoguk,
“Bepaŋ’walaŋ hebeŋ gineŋ Hatihati Uŋgoniŋ adi mapme niŋdi indiŋ tuguk wendok tuwot. Mapme wendi mihiŋiŋdok tam miŋa hinamuni titiŋdok kale nanaŋe tiulidokoguk.
Tiulidokodapmaaŋ kwanai-meŋiye yeniŋkulune me medenai koom kameyemguk u yahaŋene ugiŋ. Wooŋ yeniŋgiŋ iŋgoŋ moŋ yoŋa wabi hakiŋ,

kaŋ kwanai-meŋiye noli kotigoŋ yeniŋkula indiŋ yeniŋguk, ‘Hidi uneŋ wooŋ me nai tiyemgut heki u yenineŋ. Nu nemenemek agaŋ tiulidokoŋat tiŋa kale makaune kakahi u yenimbene dobuheŋit, tiŋa nemenemek agaŋ tiulidokoŋit, doktiŋa buune memetam u yehikiulaŋa nanadifo tinim.’
“Unduŋ yobune wooŋ yeniŋgiŋ iŋgoŋ adi u nadilakataaŋ me niŋ dinina kwanaiŋiŋde mauguk, kaŋ me noli adi muneeŋŋiŋ kwanai tibene mauguk,
kaŋ noliyeŋ medenai tiŋa ugiŋ heki u yohoneeŋ widihiŋa, widihikumuŋ tigiŋ.
Kaŋ me mapme adi u nadiŋa weleŋ gouyeune mikmeŋiye yeniŋkulune wooŋ me mik tigiŋ heki u widihikumuŋa yohikwehik wanakaŋ kula hedapmaŋ tiyemgiŋ.
“Kaŋ me mapmedi kwanai-meŋiye nolibo kutiyeniŋa yeniŋguk, ‘Muni agaŋ tiulidokoŋat, iŋgoŋ me nai tiyemgut adi kudi kadakaniŋ tubune kawe tuwot mu tilak. Unduŋ doktiŋa adi mu buneŋ,
ale hidi wooŋ yokwet wapuhi diniŋ tali giyoki haliulak tuwot wooŋ meeniŋ neeŋ yehitubu-mintaaŋ yahaŋeune budapmaŋ tineŋ.’
“Kaŋ kwanai-meŋiye adi tali giyoki haliuguk indigoŋ tuwot wooŋ me fofohi be hogohi u hogok kaka yanagilune buŋa bopyot u fotokiŋa ikiŋ.
“Kaŋ mapmedi fooŋ me nalum bugiŋ heki u yabuŋa uguk, uuyeŋ me niŋ hinamuni diniŋ tinahukut mu tiŋa bu ikuk kaŋ niŋguk,
‘Du detiŋa tinahukut hogoli tiŋa labu itaŋ?’

“Unduŋ ninadiune me u mede toboniŋ mu tubu-udaneeŋ hogok ikuk. Kaŋ Mapmedi kwanai-meŋiye indiŋ yeniŋguk, ‘Hidi me i kayoŋ kohoŋ tawadi ibikilitiŋa tobo tukulune mambip gineŋ uŋoŋ fooŋ koyoneeŋ masiŋkilip hatitoluwaak.’
Nadiiŋ be? Bepaŋ adi meeniŋ fee yeniyehimanelak iŋgoŋ lufomgoŋ yabukahilelak.”
Jesu talamut tiŋa Sisadok takis kameiŋ wendok ninadigiŋ
Jesudi unduŋ yenimbune Falisi heki adi wooŋ bopneeŋ mede tali dediŋ foloŋ kameeŋ niŋkamandane debek yobu kanim yoŋa mede tiulidokogiŋ.

Unduŋ tiŋa mihihiye tiŋa Helot’walaaniŋ me noli adi yeniŋkulune wooŋ indiŋ yogiŋ, “Henale, indi du’walaŋ mebige agaŋ nadiyam. Du yalaŋ mu yolaŋ. Du mede biyagoŋ hogok yolaŋ. Be Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede u me loloŋnit be fofoŋnit indi wanakaŋ didimeŋgoŋ hinek ninindakaleeŋ ninilaŋ. Tiŋa me loloŋnitdok nadibedi mu tiŋa yolaŋ
doktiŋa ninimbeŋ. Lomahi’walaŋ mapme Sisadok takis kameyam u du nadiune kedem be tilak be moŋ?”
Unduŋ ninadigiŋ kaŋ adi nadinadihik hogoli u agaŋ kanadiŋa yeniŋguk, “Yalaŋ-me heki hidi! Maŋgoŋde naniŋkamanda tiiŋ?
Hidi muneeŋ takisdok kameiŋ u nambu kawit.” Unduŋ yeniŋguk kaŋ adi muneeŋ niŋ tiŋa miŋgiŋ.
Mimbune kaŋ yeninadiguk, “Welewele tiŋa kudi i nedi’walaŋ?”
Yeninadiune yogiŋ, “Sisa’walaŋ.” Unduŋ yobune yeniŋguk, “Nemek Sisa’walaŋ u Sisadok miyaneeŋ, eŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ u Bepaŋdok miyaneeŋ.”
Unduŋ yenimbune adi u nadiŋa boho tiŋa wabiŋa ugiŋ.
Sadusi me hekidi meeniŋ kumuŋa koti pilatneeŋdok Jesu ninadigiŋ
Melenai wendegoŋ Sadusi hekidibo Jesu ninadine bugiŋ. Me heki u metam kumuŋa koti mu pilatneeŋ yoyagiŋ ala buŋa niŋgiŋ,

“Henale, Mosesdi Yodoko Mede niŋ indiŋ youtnimguk, ‘Me niŋ adi tam tiŋa wapmihi nemu yehitubu-mintaaŋ kumumbune kaŋ me wendiniŋ kwayaŋdibo tam kahat uŋakoŋ nagila wapmihi me kumuŋ tugukdok yehitubu-mintaluwaak.’
Heleniŋ indi’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋnik foloŋ hekidalit 7 hatigiŋ, ala Tuwodi tam niŋ nagikuk. Nagila wapmihi nemu yehitubu-mintaaŋ kumuŋguk, kaŋ Monedibo tam uŋakoŋ nagikuk.
Adi maaŋ undugoŋ wapmihi nemu tubumintaaŋ kumuŋguk, kaŋ Gikdibo tam uŋakoŋ nagikuk. Unduŋ hogok titawooŋ kwayahik dikineŋdi nagila kumumbune
tam u maaŋ hogok hatiŋa wooŋ kumuŋguk.
Me hekidalit 7 adi tam kubugoŋ uŋakoŋ nagikiŋ ala kougoŋ nai wapum foloŋ pilatneeneŋ tam u neditok tibaak?”
Unduŋ ninadiune Jesudi indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi Yodoko Mede be Bepaŋ’walaŋ saŋiniŋ mu kanadidakaleeŋ mede yogiyondafit tiiŋ.
Indiŋ nadineŋ. Pilapilat nai foloŋ pilali metamdi hekimalam koti mu tineeŋ. Adi kunum foloŋ aŋelo hatiiŋ undihi mintaaŋ hogok hatineeŋ.
Tiŋa hidi kumuŋa pilapilatdok maaŋ yoiŋ doktiŋa indiŋ hanimbe. Bepaŋdi mede indiŋ haniŋguk u hidi kunatnadi mube tiiŋ?
“‘Nu Abalaham eŋ Aisak tiŋa Jekop heki’walaŋ Bepaŋ.’ Adi yadi kumuhi’walaŋ Bepaŋ moŋ. Adi yadi kaipmuhi’walaŋ Bepaŋ.”
Jesudi mede unduŋ yobune metambop wapumdi medeŋiŋ u nadiune uŋgoniŋ hinek tuguk.
Jesu talamula Yodoko Mede dendi wapum loloŋnit hinek tilak ninadigiŋ
Jesudi mede i yobune Sadusi heki adi mede yodok talii lohigiŋ, kaŋ Falisi hekidi u nadiŋa bopneeŋ
me nohik niŋ Yodoko Mede nadidapmaŋ hinek tuluguk ala adi nimbune Jesu’walaŋ nadinadi kameka kameka tibe indiŋ ninadiguk,
“Henale, Yodoko Mede deŋdi wapum be loloŋnit hinek?”
Unduŋ ninadiune Jesudi indiŋ niŋguk, “‘Du Wapum Bepaŋge welegedi be munabuligedi be nadinadigedi aditok hogok mindapmaluwaaŋ.’
Yodoko Mede yendi loloŋnit hinek tiŋa timeŋ tilak.
Tiŋa noliŋiŋ nimaaŋ hatak, u maaŋ undiniŋgoŋ. Woŋ adi indiŋ, ‘Du datok nadilaŋ undugoŋ hinek metam nolidok nadiyemiluwaaŋ.’
Yodoko Mede lufom yeŋdi Moses tiŋa polofet heki’walaŋ mede yehikiudapmalak.”
Jesu ne’walaŋ mebi yoneŋdok Falisi heki yeninadiguk
Falisi me heki uŋgoŋ bopneeŋ hatune Jesudi indiŋ yeninadiguk,
“Hidi Kilisto nedi’walaŋ yalaki niiŋ?” Kaŋ adibo niŋgiŋ, “Dewit’walaŋ yalakiŋiŋ.”
Unduŋ yobune Jesudi indiŋ yeninadiguk, “Kaŋ dediŋ doktiŋa Dewit adi Munabulidi nimbune Kilistodok ‘Wapumne’ niŋguk? Tiŋa indiŋ yoguk.

content.text: ‘Wapumdi nu’walaŋ Wapumne indiŋ niŋguk, “Du kohone didimeniŋneŋkade itune memikgeye kayoge falipmeŋ yapmewaat.”’

content: Dewit adi ‘Wapumne’ niŋguk, iŋgoŋ dediŋ tiŋa Kilisto adi Dewit yalakiŋiŋ tilak?”
Unduŋ yeninadiune adi’walaaniŋ nebek niŋdi mede toboniŋ nemu tubu-udanemiŋguk. Unduŋ tiŋa mindaŋkade kotigoŋ ninadidok munta tiŋa wabigiŋ.
